title: Ferret: Refer and Ground Anything Anywhere at Any Granularity
authors_zh: Haoxuan You, Haotian Zhang, Zhe Gan, Xianzhi Du, Bowen Zhang, Zirui Wang, Liangliang Cao, Shih-Fu Chang, Yinfei Yang
paper_type_zh: 开放指令数据集与构造方法研究
best_for_zh: 构建允许用户圈选任意区域并提问的视觉界面
one_line: Ferret's GRIT corpus serializes points, boxes, and free-form regions into about 1.1M grounded conversations.
Ferret 的 GRIT 语料把点、框和自由形状区域序列化为约 110 万条定位对话。
why: unifying multiple region granularities in one serialized dialogue contract
inclusion_reason: GRIT is a public Track 01 training object: image, point/box/free-form region, referring phrase, instruction, and grounded response; it is consumed by region-aware multimodal SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal assistants usually accept only whole images or rectangular boxes, so users cannot refer naturally to tiny, irregular, or nested regions.

The paper's decision boundary is the released GRIT training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains image, point/box/free-form region, referring phrase, instruction, and grounded response; its selection boundary is region coordinates/masks, source labels, and referring/grounding benchmark scores, and the records are consumed by region-aware multimodal SFT.

L4 facts: the official ICLR 2024 page, public records at https://github.com/apple/ml-ferret#grit-dataset, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

多模态助手通常只接收整图或矩形框，用户难以自然指代微小、不规则或嵌套区域。

Ferret 用混合区域编码器配合 GRIT 对话，在同一记录中表示点、框和自由区域，并同时训练指代与定位。 该方法直接产出 GRIT。本卡的决策边界是可下载训练记录，而不是只有模型的报告或只用于评测的基准；单条记录包含 图像、点或框或自由形状区域、指代表达、指令与定位回答。

L4 事实：已于 2026-07-27 核验 ICLR 2024 官方页面、https://github.com/apple/ml-ferret#grit-dataset 的实际公开记录、规模和条款。收录理由是论文中心贡献直接构造或筛选可序列化的后训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Ferret combines a hybrid region encoder with GRIT records that express points, boxes, and free-form regions in the same conversation, training both referring and grounding directions. The closest comparison is whole-image LLaVA and box-only grounding assistants; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is GRIT and the feedback boundary is region coordinates/masks, source labels, and referring/grounding benchmark scores, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: public detection and segmentation annotations expanded into hierarchical referring conversations. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing image, point/box/free-form region, referring phrase, instruction, and grounded response advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: GPT-4-assisted instruction generation anchored to known regions produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply region coordinates/masks, source labels, and referring/grounding benchmark scores; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form about 1.1 million grounded refer-and-answer records stored as JSON annotations with images, regions, and conversations and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for region-aware multimodal SFT and compare against whole-image LLaVA and box-only grounding assistants. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：Ferret 用混合区域编码器配合 GRIT 对话，在同一记录中表示点、框和自由区域，并同时训练指代与定位。 输出及流转：得到包含 图像、点或框或自由形状区域、指代表达、指令与定位回答 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 约 110 万条多粒度定位对话 以 JSON 标注、图像引用和区域信息 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The same 7B/13B base gains on referring expression comprehension, referring generation, and region dialogue after GRIT training; 1.1M hierarchical records supply the controlled supervision surface.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 43 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

同一 7B 或 13B 基础模型在加入 GRIT 后，指代表达理解、指代生成和区域对话均改善；约 110 万条层次化记录提供了明确监督面。结果支持多粒度数据，但不解除非商业许可限制。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 43 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: whole-image LLaVA and box-only grounding assistants. The actual change is unifying multiple region granularities in one serialized dialogue contract. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect models may learn annotation conventions instead of robust spatial grounding.
相对最近的共同做法，在同一对话契约中统一点、边界框和自由形状区域三种粒度。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 模型可能学习标注格式而非真实空间关系。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. GRIT is non-commercial
  2. generated language can expose source category labels
  3. region sampling favors annotated objects over unlabelled context.

1. GRIT 的非商业许可限制工业复用。
  2. 生成文本可能泄露上游类别名称，夸大开放词汇能力。
  3. 区域采样偏向已有标注物体，未标注背景覆盖不足。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For building an interface where a user circles an arbitrary region and asks for an explanation, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of models may learn annotation conventions instead of robust spatial grounding.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: region coordinates/masks, source labels, and referring/grounding benchmark scores. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要构建允许用户圈选任意区域并提问的视觉界面，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 模型可能学习标注格式而非真实空间关系。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
